instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, schedules, sheets, and built-in export commands. Start from a blank Revit project. Using the Revit GUI, create a single-storey clinic with an overall rectangular footprint of 20.0 m by 14.0 m near the project origin. The exterior walls should define the full footprint and rise about 3.3 m, with one ground slab and a roof covering the footprint. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, one IfcBuildingStorey, seven IfcSpace entities, nine IfcWall entities, one IfcSlab, one IfcRoof, seven IfcDoor entities, and six IfcWindow entities. Do not include IfcStair, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include Reception, Waiting, at least two Consultation rooms, Treatment, and Staff. Export a category area schedule named result.csv with headers category,area and exactly two rows: public=51.92 and clinical/support=147.36. Export a one-page Revit plan sheet PDF named result.pdf; its sheet text must include A101 CLINIC PLAN, Consultation 1, Consultation 2, Reception, and Waiting. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
